text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Onee-chan! Don't I look a little 
different today?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Hm? Come to think of it... —...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, did you change your perfume? It's an 
exotic scent.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Bingo~! I went to an Arabian perfume shop 
the other day~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I heard what I'm wearing right now is all 
the rage in Dubai! How is it? Does it 
scream Dubai? Do I look like a celebrity!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's lovely. Musk is such a mature 
scent that complements the night view. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
For Vivlos, maybe something fruity would 
be nice?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You're an innocent, cheerful mood maker. I 
think a refreshing citrus scent would suit 
you perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Adding a touch of spice with cardamom... 
should give you a mature scent that suits 
you even better.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! Yeah, yeah, that might be 
nice♡\n...Hey, hey, Big Sis."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Yes, why don't we visit that shop 
next time? I'll pick out the one that 
suits you best.
